problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 35 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 66 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 62 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 51 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 59 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 52 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 60 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 56 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 31 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 30 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 65 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 55 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 46 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 60 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 60 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of freight. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
